flow: ui-path (ChatDriver) — ProseMirror composer insertText + Enter, newline-delimited-JSON streamed answer

steps.note: session snapshot injected (data/v0.app/.session); unauthenticated visitors are redirected to /api/auth/login?next=... — click through the GitHub/Vercel OAuth, then proceed
selector [data-slot="new-chat-button"], [aria-label="Start new chat"]; jittered 600-1300ms human dwell (both UNVERIFIED)
trusted keyboard.insertText into .ProseMirror[contenteditable="true"] (bundle-derived ProseMirror composer; fallback [contenteditable="true"])
Enter (keyEnter strategy) — bundle keydown handler preventDefaults + submits on 'Enter'; 50-200ms gate

rpc: underlying wire = POST /chat/api/chat with Accept: text/event-stream; response body is newline-delimited JSON, each line JSON.parsed and reduced client-side into the assistant message; transport wrapper events type=message|error|complete; LLM failures surface as finishReason provider_server_error[:<category>] / retry_provider_server_error[:<category>]. Resume: GET /chat/api/chat/resume?messageId=; probe: HEAD /chat/api/chat/resume/ping; latest: GET /api/chat/chat/latest?chatId=&lastSyncedAt=. Request body (bundle): chatId, messageId, messageContent {version:1, parts:[{type:'mdx', content}]}, modelConfiguration {modelId default 'v0-max', imageGenerations, thinking}, userMessageType 'message', isNew, permissionsMode 'full', attachments[], projectId, optional programmatic/sandbox{enabled}/shouldCreatePR. Response header x-v0-user-message-id = created user message id. Auth: same-origin __vercel_session cookie (provider-catalog); no Authorization bearer. The UI path drives the site's own JS, so no per-line event schema reconstruction is needed beyond what is listed.
stealth: real session, trusted inputs, site's own send handler — indistinguishable from the user typing
